# Programming-language standard — hindi

*Localization of existing standards (ISO/IEC 9899, 14882, IEEE 1800/1076, …) — not re-authorship.*

Script/locale: Devanagari · register: language · (C) 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary, GPL.

| construct | this language | Romenagri (ASCII-7) | C | localizes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `if` | अगर | `agar` | `if` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.4.1 |
| `else` | अन्यथा | `anya_thaa` | `else` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.4.1 |
| `while` | जबतक | `jabataka` | `while` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.1 |
| `for` | क्रम | `krama` | `for` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.5.3 |
| `return` | वापस | `waapasa` | `return` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.6.4 |
| `int` | पूर्णांक | `poor_naa_nka` | `int` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `void` | व्योम | `wyoma` | `void` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.7.2 |
| `printf` | लिखो | `likhoa` | `printf` | ISO/IEC 9899 §7.21.6.3 |
| `break` | तोड़ो | `toa_rdoa` | `break` | ISO/IEC 9899 §6.8.6.3 |

**Semantics are preserved**: each row maps a surface keyword onto the canonical construct; the execution target (GCC today, neuromorphic tomorrow) never sees the linguistic layer.
